name: CPS Student Advisory Council (Mikva Challenge)
what_you_do: Students from 20+ Chicago schools meet with CPS leaders. They gather ideas from peers and do research. Then they write advice on school issues. Past groups spoke to the CPS Board.
grades: Citywide Youth Councils are for current 9th to 11th graders
who_can_apply: Chicago Public Schools students ages 16 to 18. You care about making CPS schools better.
pay_detail: Pay not stated on the program pages. Ask Mikva Challenge.
duration: Summer council with policy work; exact length not stated
deadline_text: Recruitment for 2027 programs begins in spring 2027. Exact dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Recruitment for 2027 starts in the spring. Watch the Mikva Challenge program application page or email inquiries@mikvachallenge.org. Phone: (312) 863-6340.
notes: A city-wide teen council. The program page gives ages 16 to 18; the application page says Citywide Youth Councils are for current 9th to 11th graders.
